summary: A base-building timber wall module, 4 x 3 m: a stud frame of sill plate, top plate, six studs, a mid rail and… options tier; sockets socket_join_left, socket_join_right, socket_top.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.build_wall_wood or place "prefab": "build_wall_wood" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
